description: The file defines a controller class 'Cart' within the Opencart e-commerce system, providing API endpoints to manage the shopping cart, including adding products, retrieving cart contents, and calculating totals.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class handling API operations related to the shopping cart, including adding products, validating options, and retrieving cart data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the main API request for updating the cart, including processing posted products, validating options, stock, and subscriptions, and returning success or error messages.

methods.name: addProduct
methods.description: Adds a single product to the cart based on provided POST data, with validation and subscription handling.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves the current products in the cart, including subscription details.

methods.name: getTotals
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total amounts in the cart, including taxes.
